cells.question: Q05

passages.quote: Across all areas covered by the Frontier Safety Framework, Critical Capability Levels (CCLs) have not been reached.

cells.note: The direct evaluation across all framework domains is of Gemini 2.5 Pro Experimental (03-25). For Preview (05-06) and GA, the card relies on those results and repeats a subset of evaluations: the Cyber Uplift Level 1 evaluations for Preview, and the “most essential” evaluations for GA, whose deceptive-alignment evaluations were not yet completed (PDF p. 11). The evaluations reached the alert threshold for Cyber Uplift Level 1, which is not the CCL (PDF pp. 10–11).

crossFamily.result: minor, applied: the note now says which variant the direct all-domain evaluation covers and how the Preview and GA evidence was added. Status agrees.
